summary: Health assessment of legacy VB6 banking application for modernization readiness and risk areas.

hotspots.reason: Tightly coupled UI and business logic with event-driven code and no automated tests.

provenance.evidence: Command buttons directly show/hide forms; no separation of concerns.

hotspots.reason: Use of legacy COM libraries with potential for SQL injection and no ORM abstraction.

provenance.evidence: References to ADO 2.0 and DAO 3.51 libraries.

hotspots.reason: Legacy forms use password masking but no evidence of secure password storage or authentication.

provenance.evidence: PasswordChar used in textbox but no secure storage indicated.

risks.title: Security Vulnerabilities from Legacy Data Access
risks.description: Legacy ADO/DAO usage without parameterized queries risks SQL injection attacks.

risks.title: Lack of Automated Testing
risks.description: No existing automated tests increase risk of regressions during modernization.

risks.title: Tight Coupling of UI and Business Logic
risks.description: Event-driven VB6 forms tightly couple UI and logic, complicating modularization and reuse.
